sentences.en: He was also very charming, an easy smiler, witty, relaxed and vivacious.

sentences.en: As you get used to being a smiler, you'll start doing it naturally — including at the people you most want to meet.

sentences.en: Smiling is inseparable from smiler, it can neither be bought nor be rented.

sentences.en: It helped that Christian Bale, a reluctant smiler whose sharply planed face looks as if it had been carved with a chisel, slid into Bruce Wayne's insouciance as easily as he did Batman's suit.

sentences.en: In their new paper, Dr. Niedenthal and her colleagues point to a number of studies indicating that this imitation activates many of the same regions of the brain that are active in the smiler.
